parts.text: Hi! I am a new Forward Deployed Engineer ramping up on Google ADK 2.0 and Agent Runtime. How can you help me track my onboarding?
What are the four session state prefixes in Google ADK Python and how does user-scoped state work across sessions?

Google ADK supports four session state scopes: unprefixed keys (current session only), user: (persisted across all sessions for that user), app: (shared across all users of the app), and temp: (discarded after the current invocation).
